cuts.label: scout:kaicenat/kaicenat-cenat-dean-2026w29
cuts.title: Kai Cenat's dean loses it in Streamer University
cuts.retelling: Kai, playing a school dean, calmly sends students to the office, screams at one for nearly ruining his clothes before picture day, then learns a crowd outside is chanting against him.

cuts.label: kaicenat@momentcrazycarefultoadelegiggle-oiliilqfmy84fupf/kaicenat-about-asks-2026w29
cuts.title: Kai Cenat tells a guest 'no party' and the next one shows up as a villain
cuts.hook: Kai says no parties, then this happens
cuts.retelling: After Kai waves off a friendly guest with a 'no party' joke, a woman in white storms in performing a dramatic 'I've come to save you' bit, and he ends up asking if she needs medical attention.

cuts.label: kaicenat@vod2888642092/kaicenat-call-cenat-2026w41
cuts.title: Kai Cenat says he dropped everything for Reggie, then threatens to sue
cuts.hook: Kai says he called Reggie that minute
cuts.retelling: Kai Cenat says Reggie sent a 2:32 a.m. cry for help, insists he dropped a shoot, flew back and called right away, then demands Reggie's proof and says he is suing.

cuts.label: lacy@vod2890036446/lacy-backside-bare-2026w40
cuts.title: Lacy can't believe Netflix kept this in
cuts.hook: Lacy: Netflix wouldn't leave this in
cuts.retelling: Lacy watches a Netflix show, says they'd never leave a man's bare backside in, then sees it aired and says she can't believe it's on a number one show.

cuts.label: kaicenat@momentblitheblushingpresidentpicomause-qrd_dckj_ylyqepg/kaicenat-about-came-2026w38
cuts.title: Kai Cenat on forgiving his dad and making up with Bruce
cuts.hook: Kai Cenat: I've forgiven my dad
cuts.retelling: Kai says he forgave his dad, then recalls reaching out to his estranged friend Bruce after they fell out over something that could have been talked through, and the two had a dinner that he calls some grown man shit.

cuts.label: kaicenat@momentcreativeflirtydunlinm4xheh-qmubymsa6rvij7jd/kaicenat-cenat-desk-2026w29
cuts.title: Kai Cenat feels bad about the rain at his university
cuts.hook: Kai feels bad about the rain
cuts.retelling: Kai Cenat, playing dean at a university opening, keeps apologizing to students getting soaked in the rain and begs staff to let them inside, ending on 'I'm so sorry, I feel so bad, bro'.

cuts.label: jynxzi@momentconcernedresilientcheddartbtacoleft-byi_zj6x6ukzabe7/jynxzi-jynxzi-lobby-2026w37
cuts.title: Jynxzi tries to figure out what consciousness is
cuts.retelling: Jynxzi rambles about how a thought can't be seen, heard or smelled, and someone off-screen tells him it's just neurons firing.

cuts.label: kaicenat@vod2822355279/kaicenat-cenat-dean-2026w29
cuts.title: Kai Cenat as the dean screams 'get out of my office'
cuts.retelling: An angry dean kicks a visitor out over picture-day clothes, sends some students to the main office, then hears that a crowd outside is chanting against him, with no explanation of why.
